---
title: "Overnight Oats"
description: Two minutes of work tonight, breakfast solved tomorrow.
categories: [breakfast, no-cook, make-ahead, vegetarian]
time: 5 min + overnight
servings: 1
---

## Ingredients

- 50 g rolled oats
- 120 ml milk
- 2 tbsp yoghurt
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tbsp chia seeds
- A pinch of salt
- Berries, to serve

## Method

1. Put the oats, milk, yoghurt, honey, chia seeds and salt in a jar.
2. Stir properly, right down to the bottom, or you get a dry layer under the wet one.
3. Lid on, fridge, at least 6 hours.
4. In the morning, loosen with a splash more milk if it has set too firm, then top with berries.

Swap the honey for maple syrup and the yoghurt for a coconut one to make it vegan.
